questions.solution:

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is in Active voice and is an assertive statement. This will be changed to passive voice.
 
• The verb here has two objects, direct and indirect object.
 
• While changing the voice form in a sentence-- the places of the subject and the object are interchanged. In the passive voice, the object word is preceded by the word--by.
 
• The subject of the active voice changes as the object of the passive voice. The object of the active voice changes as the subject of the passive voice.
 
• In the given active sentence **I **is the **subject** and **all the** **documents** in the **object.** When we change it to passive as mentioned above the active voice **subject **becomes the **object. **And the active voice **object **becomes the **subject**.
 
• Out of all given options, we get the correct sentence in passive voice '**It is promised by me to furnish all the documents required for the assignment**.' 
 
• Thus **option 1** is the correct answer.

Given below are the rules of tense conversion from Active to Passive Voice and vice verse:

 
 

 
 
**TENSE**

 
 
 
**SENTENCE IN ACTIVE VOICE**

**Does** he **not sell** books?

Books **are not being sold** by him.

 
**Are** books **not sold** by him?

 
 
 

 
 
**PRESENT PERFECT**

 
 
 
He **has completed **the work.

 
He** has not completed** the work.

 
**Has **he **completed **the work?

 
 
 
The work **has been completed** by him.

 
The work **has not been completed** by him.

 
**Has **the work **been completed **by him?

**Did **he **complete **the work?

 
 
 
The work **was completed** by him.

 
The work **was not completed** by him.

 
**Was **the work **completed** by him?

 
 
 

 
 
**PAST PROGRESSIVE**

 
 
 
He **was reading **a book.

**Was **he **reading** a book?

 
 
 
A book **was being read **by him.

 
A book **was being read** by him.

 
 

 
Was a book** being read **by him?

 
 
 

 
 
**PAST PERFECT**

**SIMPLE FUTURE**
